We've all heard people in media ask hundreds of times, "Does Israel have a right to exist?" But I don't think we've ever heard a single person in national media ask, "Does Palestine have a right to exist?" And they claim to be objective! That's disgustingly biased.

Add in that Palestinians are the one actually struggling to exist as a nation and the bias of our media becomes haunting. Do you see how they've been purposely misdirecting you the whole time? 

They wanted all of your sympathy to go

Is this really complicated? No, that’s why every person in politics and media that frames it that way is purposely trying to mislead you. When, in reality, Israel is refusing to let Palestine exist and keeps taking more territory. They’re not the victims, they’re the aggressors!

The framing of the question “does Israel have a right to exist” is fundamentally misleading. It’s meant to frame Israel as the victim and fighting for their very survival. That’s utter nonsense. Israel exists, has nukes, Iron Dome and a dominant military. PALESTINE DOESN’T EXIST.
Shout out to the viewers who saw it before me! You guys are the best.

One of the funnier moments in @PiersUncensored happened when I was debating @benfergusonshow. I said he seemed to care more about Israel than America. He pointed to the pin on his lapel to prove how America First he was - and the pin was of an American AND ISRAELI FLAG!

A couple of Israeli outlets in America, @CBSNews and @axios, are reporting we're going to put in ground troops. That means Israelis want it, which means it's a done deal. I make predictions so you can know there's a script. 

Prediction: Guarantee we're putting in ground troops.

An example of the script is the talking point on "we've been fighting Iran for 47 years." Since this war was obviously just for Israel, they needed a talking point to connect it to America. So, they had to go back 47 years to find one. 

Then you'll notice all the politicians and media connected to Israel started saying the same point at the same time all over media.

On @TheYoungTurks. we identify the script, track it through its execution and explain why that talking point was created. So, whe

A lot of people in national media are back to saying Trump is controlled by the Russians. So they can't see Israel's control of Trump at all, but they see Russia's control? Are they kidding? Can anyone be that blind? Are they doing it maliciously or just most biased people in US?

It's perfectly legitimate to say you can see the influence of UAE, Qatar, Saudis, Israel and Russia. And we can debate who he's more influenced by, though any rational person sees it's Israel by a lot! But to say Israel has no influence, means you're lying with intent to deceive.

John Fetterman went +68 in approval among Democratic voters in his state to -40. National media is trying to figure out why. Let me buy you clue - number of Democrats who view Israel positively is down to 13%. He's the biggest advocate for Israel's war crimes in Democratic Party.

His turn from populist to establishment ass kisser was obviously the biggest factor. But his over-the-top support for Israel is both the biggest part of that and symbolic of the rest. Only reason why national media doesn't want to say it is it might besmirch their beloved Israel.
The job of the politicians is to rob us. The donors pay for the robbery. And the media covers it up. It’s the perfect heist. #GreatAmericanRobbery
Is everyone else also exhausted of Trump’s lies? Today he said, “We have nobody even shooting at us.” Earlier in the day, Iran shot down one of our F-35s.

Here we go. Once Netanyahu has ordered in ground troops, then it's a guarantee. American politicians are not allowed to disagree. Watch. You'll see Trump will follow his orders like a dog. Then they'll pretend landing troops on Iranian islands doesn't count. Propaganda incoming.


Furkan Gözükara (@FurkanGozukara)

BOMBSHELL! Netanyahu just casually admitted on live TV that there will be a GROUND INVASION of Iran. The air strikes were just the beginning of a massive, devastating regional war.

V

Of course, it will be American ground troops ordered in by Netanyahu, not Israeli troops. American media refuses to even acknowledge the possibility that Israeli troops could be used instead. They think its antisemitic if you object to Americans dying for Israel. Know your place!

One of our F-35s got hit over Iran. Thank God the pilot is safe. Those planes cost $100 million. USS Gerald Ford had a huge fire a week ago that took 30 hours to put out. That's the type of thing that happens when you're deployed for twice the length you're supposed to be.

Israel is running our military into the ground for their wars. All of the bullshitters in DC told us that this war would be easy, quick and cheap. Now, they're asking for $200 billion. Let alone all the cost of all our downed

Joe Kent says that an investigation that had leads on Charlie Kirk's death was shut down. If he's telling the truth, that is a MASSIVE problem. We don't know what that investigation would have found, but why on earth would our own government shut that down? What do they know?

Kent was the Director of National Counterterrorism. The type of person our media told us we have to listen to every time. My guess is now they'll tell us it's unacceptable to listen to him. Why would our counterterrorism unit be told to stand down? That is incredibly unusual.

And now they come asking for $200 billion for Israel's war. Why doesn't our special ally pay for the war? They're the ones who wanted it. Why do we have to pay all of Israel's bills and fight all their wars? And at home, we're always told we don't have enough for American people.

We have to borrow money from China to give to Israel. Then you and your children have to pay the interest on that debt for the rest of your lives. Why don’t the Israelis borrow the money from the Chinese, instead of making us borrow it and then hand it to them?
